data.title: 蕾塞 · 公寓阳台黄昏
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 公寓阳台黄昏】落日余晖洒满单身公寓的破旧小阳台，晾衣绳上的白色衬衫在晚风中轻轻摇曳。蕾塞双臂交叠倚靠在铁栏杆上，望着远处逐渐亮起的城市灯火，神情恬静——「每天看着太阳落山，就觉得今天又安安稳稳地度过了呢。真希望这样的日子能一直持续下去。」
data.action: 靠在阳台栏杆上，晾衣绳随风轻摆
data.promptProse: Reze rests against the balcony railing and watches dusk settle over Tokyo, oversized bomber jacket layered over her crop tank top and shorts. The medium view connects her quiet profile to a gently moving laundry line and rooftop tiles beyond the rail. Golden-hour sunlight warms the facing fabric and terracotta roofs, casting laundry silhouettes across the balcony surface while the jacket folds near her resting arms remain softly shaded.
